compositionOwner.name: CurrentSpecWorkbenchPage
compositionOwner.responsibility: compose the six measured target regions from one truth-adapted presentation model while keeping loading, degraded and ready states in the same geometry

contract.topology: left back control, horizontally centered route title and one square templates action
contract.interaction: back returns to specialization_home/builds_home; right action opens profile/templates

contract.topology: one continuous framed identity row with left medallion, title/source/context copy and right specialization picker affordance
interactions: the single trailing right chevron selects specialization
the context line selects scenario and keeps its down chevron adjacent to the context text

contract.topology: one large forged panel with left status/headline/divider/two reasons/primary action and one reserved emblem well on the right
contract.interaction: retry on route failure, otherwise open the first blocking module or SimC submit when ready

contract.topology: exactly four equal vertical cards with a top-left state pennant, circular module socket, title, two-line truthful summary and bottom chevron
contract.stableInvariant: all four cards remain mounted and equal in every route state; a disabled action cannot change card size

contract.topology: one continuous forged ledger with one title band and four icon-led rows separated only horizontally
forbidden: generic grid frame around each cell

contract.responsibility: frame layer, content-safe inset, stable region metadata and explicit frame asset status

rejectedReuse.reason: the old icon plus generic 2x2 module-card composition does not match the measured warning panel, four-card deck or continuous ledger
a generic titled panel cannot own any authored workbench region
a standalone loading/error panel replaces target geometry and causes the forbidden blank first viewport
the ledger is a continuous authored list composition; table borders and independent cells caused repeated visual rejection

layoutContract.rule: the H5 comparison uses the native 390px stage without screenshot scaling; small one-pixel optical inset differences may be component-specific but cannot create drifting outer columns
layoutContract.nativeSafeArea: PageFrame and AppShell own WeChat safe areas; this pushed route has no product TabBar and may compact declared vertical gaps only after H5 composition passes

stateContract.loadingRule: render the same header, hero, readiness panel, four modules and four ledger rows immediately; only copy, state and asset readiness change
stateContract.degradedRule: partial, stale, blocked and error states keep every measured region and expose exact provenance or blocker copy
stateContract.clippingRule: visible text and actions stay inside the 390px stage at DPR2 and inside the WeChat safe-area viewport

implementationOrder: route-specific unified assets after component bounds stabilize
